approach: Add a `hidden: &[String]` argument (directory paths such as `studies/a`) to `Snapshot::create`. The internal materialize step drops every path at or under a hidden directory, next to `records/` and `athena-exclude` paths. The public `materialize` keeps its 4-argument signature and delegates with an empty list, so its one outside caller (run/mod.rs:2414) is untouched. `Snapshot` stores the list. `change_list()` and `history_text` drop paths under it, so a hidden directory is absent from both sides of every diff the agent sees and is never reported as deleted. `build_candidate` applies the change entries to the full base tree, so `studies/a` lands byte-identical. A new helper `Athena::hidden_study_dirs(ctx)` in run/pin.rs reads the pinned URL from the job record (`ctx.job.job.pin.url`, already set when the context is built at mod.rs:1272-1283) and returns every `studies/<d>` at the base commit whose `pin.json` `repository_url` differs from it or is unreadable. A change job has no pin, so it gets an empty list. This needs no new `RunContext` field. `producer_snapshot` and `verifier_snapshot` use it. The reader, which runs before the capability is known, hides other studies only when the request names exactly one configured study system. Every other caller passes `&[]`. Then add `[capabilities.study.systems.hermes-agent]` to athena.toml and leave firstmate's lines untouched. PRECONDITION: this base has no systems schema (config.rs:401 `CapabilityConfig`; no `systems` hit in config.rs). Step 1 stops the producer if it is still missing.

decisions.choice: Choose the studies to hide by the pinned repository URL: keep `studies/<d>` only if its pin.json `repository_url` equals the URL of the system the job pinned (`PinnedRepo.url`); hide all others, including ones with no readable pin.json.
decisions.reason: study_pin (pin.rs:82-110) already joins a study to a repository by pin.json `repository_url`. pin_repo has resolved the job's system to a URL before any snapshot exists. This avoids a study-id-to-system-id naming convention, which does not hold: the existing directory is `firstmate-work-handling`, not `firstmate`. Hiding what cannot be proven to belong to the system is the safe default for S1.

rejected.option: Hide by directory name equal to the system id
rejected.why: firstmate's own study studies/firstmate-work-handling would be hidden from its own job.
It needs a second mapping from system id to config key, and older pins may lack the field; the URL is already the join key.

decisions.choice: Take the hidden list from the job record's pin (`ctx.job.job.pin`) in a helper in pin.rs, with no new `RunContext` field; keep the public `materialize` signature and pass the list only to `Snapshot::create`.
decisions.reason: This answers findings 3 and 4: it cuts the extra files to the minimum. run/mod.rs gets one changed line (the verifier_snapshot call at 1937). The replay `materialize` call at mod.rs:2414 stays unchanged. checks.rs:663 gets one changed line because `verifier_snapshot` gains a required parameter.

rejected.option: Add `hidden: Vec<String>` to RunContext, computed after pin_repo
rejected.why: It touches the struct, its constructor and the replay call in mod.rs for no gain, since the pin is already on the job record.

rejected.option: Keep `verifier_snapshot` unchanged and add a second hiding variant
rejected.why: The old entry would stay opt-out, so checks.rs:663 or a new caller could leak studies without noticing.

decisions.choice: Make the list an explicit required parameter of `Snapshot::create` and `verifier_snapshot`, and update every caller. Callers with no agent reader (baseline checks checks.rs:955, planning.rs:138 and :292, steward.rs:255) pass `&[]`.
decisions.reason: A forgotten call site cannot compile, so none can silently skip the hiding.

rejected.why: Those are per repository and commit, not per job; they would hide studies from change jobs too.

decisions.choice: `change_list()` and `history_text` drop paths under a hidden directory instead of refusing the job.
decisions.reason: The base commit and work tree of the snapshot both lack the hidden directory, so nothing is reported deleted. A stray file the producer writes under the hidden name is dropped, so landing leaves the directory unchanged, as the request asks.

rejected.option: Refuse a job whose producer writes under a hidden directory
rejected.why: A new study whose name collides with a hidden one would stop an otherwise good run; the request asks for unchanged landing, not refusal.

decisions.choice: The reader hides other systems' studies only when the request text contains exactly one configured study-system id as a whole word (so `hermes` does not match `hermes-agent`, and `studies/hermes-agent/x` does). It then keeps studies whose pin URL is that system's repo_url. Naming none or several hides nothing.
decisions.reason: The reader's snapshot is made at reading.rs:551 before its reading chooses a capability; naming one system is the only case where the job is known to be a study of system b. This is a file-visibility rule and refuses nothing, so refusal_corpus has no case for it (its cases at refusal_corpus.rs:292 onward test reading checks, listed in INPUT_FORMS at :90). The input forms are covered by unit tests added in reading.rs: id alone, id inside a path, id as prefix of another id, two ids named, no id, and different case.

rejected.option: Always hide all studies from the reader
rejected.why: A change request such as 'fix studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json' needs to see them.
Criterion 2 requires the reader's snapshot to omit other studies.

decisions.choice: Commit-shape outcomes of the rule. Job commit that edits a visible path: lands as before. Job commit that also writes a hidden path: the hidden entry is dropped from the change list and the rest lands. Records-only commit: `records/` is already absent from the snapshot, unchanged. Owner-path (athena-exclude) commit: classify still hides it, unchanged. Intervention commit on the base: it is part of the base tree; a studies/<other> path in it is hidden from a study job's HISTORY.txt and tree, and visible to change jobs. Retry-after-block landing: BaseThenTree seeds from the rejected candidate's full tree, and materialize hides the same directories, so the retry's change list is still against the hidden base.
decisions.reason: No landing, history-check or attribution classification function changes; only agent snapshot contents and the snapshot's own change list do. Callers of change_list: run/producer.rs and the candidate build (candidate.rs:26-113), tested by the criterion 3 test and the existing run tests.

rejected.option: Change landing or history-check code to know about hidden paths
rejected.why: It is not needed, because the hidden paths never enter the snapshot repository.

risks.risk: The systems schema is absent from the base I read, so criterion 1 and the athena.toml entry cannot be shown to hold.
risks.mitigation: Step 1 is a stop condition: the producer reads crates/athena-data/src/config.rs for a `systems` map with repo_url and repo_ref and for how a job names its system. If either is missing it stops with a report and lands nothing. The hiding steps do not depend on the schema except the reader rule, which needs the list of configured system ids.

risks.risk: A study directory with no readable pin.json is hidden from every study job, including its own system's job.
risks.mitigation: Study rules already require a pin.json per study (cap-study rules). The decision states it, and a test covers a directory with no pin.json being hidden.

risks.risk: The reader hides studies for any request that names one study-system id, even a change request that mentions it (for example, editing another study).
risks.mitigation: The match is a whole-word match of exactly one configured system id; naming none or several hides nothing. A change job's producer and verifier see all studies, because their hiding follows the pinned capability. Tested in reading.rs and run/tests.rs.

risks.risk: A producer that writes under a hidden directory name has the file silently left out of the change list.
risks.mitigation: The criterion 3 test fixes this behavior: the rest of the job lands and the hidden directory is byte-identical, which is what the request asks.

risks.risk: Records of earlier studies and the evidence snapshot's history may still describe another system's study.
risks.mitigation: Out of scope: the request restricts the change to studies/<id>/ in agent snapshots. I did not read the evidence snapshot's full content.

risks.risk: Three test helpers drop `repo_url`/`repo_ref` lines and would leave an empty Hermes table that may fail to parse, breaking every test built from athena.toml.
risks.mitigation: Step 7 changes the helpers (run_pin_tests.rs:94, run/tests.rs:307, scope_guard.rs:1058) to drop systems tables; the full `cargo test --locked` run covers them.
